title: Turning Quantum Compiler Configuration Selection Upside Down: A Top-Down Paradigm
title_zh: 颠覆量子编译器配置选择：一种自顶向下的范式

paragraphs.en: Selecting an effective quantum compiler configuration requires coordinated decisions over both hardware targets and compiler settings, with the ultimate goal of improving circuit execution fidelity. Existing state-of-the-art approaches such as MQT Predictor typically decompose this problem into two sequential stages: a device is chosen first, after which compiler options are tuned on that device through iterative reinforcement-learning-based search. This bottom-up strategy can be fundamentally limited by its initial device decision, since a poorly matched backend may constrain the best fidelity achievable regardless of how effectively later compiler options are optimized. In contrast to classical compiler tuning, where the search space is often prohibitively large, the configuration space of practical quantum compilation remains manageable enough to support exhaustive offline evaluation. This property opens up a different possibility: rather than repeatedly searching from candidate configurations, one can derive reusable configuration knowledge from offline oracle results and apply it directly to unseen circuits.
paragraphs.zh: 选择一个有效的量子编译器配置需要对硬件目标和编译器设置进行协同决策，其最终目标是提升电路执行保真度。 现有的最先进方法（如 MQT Predictor）通常将这一问题分解为两个顺序执行的阶段：首先选择一个设备，然后在该设备上通过基于强化学习的迭代搜索来调整编译器选项。 这种自底向上的策略可能会从根本上受到其初始设备决策的限制，因为一个匹配不佳的后端可能会约束所能达到的最佳保真度，无论后续的编译器选项优化得多么有效。 与经典编译器调优中搜索空间往往大到令人望而却步的情况不同，实用量子编译的配置空间仍然足够可控，可以支持穷举式的离线评估。 这一特性开启了另一种可能性：不必从候选配置中反复搜索，而是可以从离线预言机结果中推导出可复用的配置知识，并将其直接应用于未见过的电路。

paragraphs.en: Based on this idea, in this paper, we introduce a top-down configuration-selection paradigm and build QuOptBench, an exhaustively characterized benchmark containing empirical oracle configurations for 268 quantum circuits. We first study whether LLMs can directly infer suitable configurations and evaluate ten representative models. The results reveal that vanilla LLMs often favor unnecessarily complex compiler settings and therefore remain far from the oracle. We then employ Claude-Opus-5 to examine oracle decisions from 68 sampled circuits and extract 13 transferable rules governing device and compiler-option selection. Using these rules together with lightweight predictors trained on the complete enumerated configuration data of the sampled circuits, we design QCompass, a compact rule-guided ML framework that performs fast configuration selection without iterative online search. Across our evaluation, the distilled rules consistently strengthen LLM-based selection, while QCompass provides the strongest overall balance between solution quality and selection latency among the compared methods. These results indicate that transferring knowledge from offline oracle characterization offers a promising alternative to conventional bottom-up quantum compiler tuning.
paragraphs.zh: 基于这一思路，本文提出了一种自上而下的配置选择范式，并构建了 QuOptBench——一个包含 268 个量子电路的经验性最优配置的全面表征基准。 我们首先研究大语言模型能否直接推断合适的配置，并评估了十个代表性模型。 结果表明，未经调优的大语言模型往往偏好不必要的复杂编译器设置，因此与最优配置仍相去甚远。 随后，我们使用 Claude-Opus-5 检查来自 68 个抽样电路的最优配置决策，并提取出 13 条关于设备与编译器选项选择的可迁移规则。 利用这些规则以及在这些电路的完整枚举配置数据上训练的轻量级预测器，我们设计了 QCompass——一个紧凑的规则引导机器学习框架，无需迭代在线搜索即可执行快速配置选择。 在我们的评估中，蒸馏出的规则持续增强了基于大语言模型的选择效果，而在所比较的方法中，QCompass 在解决方案质量与选择延迟之间提供了最佳的整体平衡。 这些结果表明，从离线的最优配置表征中迁移知识，为传统的自下而上量子编译器调优提供了一种有前景的替代方案。

paragraphs.en: Quantum computing has rapidly advanced with the development of both quantum hardware and software ( Harrow et al., 2009 ; Cao et al., 2019 ; Peruzzo et al., 2014 ; Liang et al., 2024 ) . Unlike compilation for classical programs, quantum compilation must account for noisy and error-prone quantum hardware. Therefore, the quality of a compiled circuit on a target device is commonly measured by execution fidelity ( Jozsa, 1994 ) , which reflects the combined effects of compilation and hardware characteristics, such as topology and gate errors.
paragraphs.zh: 随着量子硬件和量子软件的发展，量子计算已迅速取得进展（Harrow et al., 2009；Cao et al., 2019；Peruzzo et al., 2014；Liang et al., 2024）。 与经典程序的编译不同，量子编译必须考虑充满噪声且易出错的量子硬件。 因此，编译后的电路在目标设备上的质量通常用执行保真度（Jozsa, 1994）来衡量，它反映了编译与硬件特性（如拓扑结构和门错误）的综合影响。

paragraphs.en: As illustrated in Fig. 1(a) , quantum compilation involves two closely coupled decisions. The first is device selection . Since different quantum devices have distinct gate error rates and connectivity topology, selecting a suitable device for each circuit is critical to maximizing execution fidelity, analogous to routing requests to appropriate LLMs ( Feng et al., 2026 ) . The second is option selection , which determines how the circuit is compiled for the selected device through stages including layout, routing, translation, etc. Importantly, first-stage device decision defines the hardware constraints and error characteristics for all subsequent compilation stages.
paragraphs.zh: 如图1(a)所示，量子编译涉及两个紧密耦合的决策。 第一个是设备选择。 由于不同的量子设备具有不同的门错误率和连接拓扑，为每个电路选择合适的设备对于最大化执行保真度至关重要，这类似于将请求路由到合适的大语言模型（Feng et al., 2026）。 第二个是选项选择，它决定如何针对所选设备对电路进行编译，包括布局、路由、翻译等阶段。 重要的是，第一阶段的设备决策定义了后续所有编译阶段的硬件约束和错误特性。

paragraphs.en: Therefore, we formulate the joint selection of suitable devices and compiler options for quantum circuits as quantum compiler configuration selection . In classical compilers, a similar problem is compiler auto-tuning , which has been addressed using heuristic search ( Chen et al., 2021 ; Zhu et al., 2024 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ; Garciarena and Santana, 2016 ; Pan et al., 2025 ; Hoste and Eeckhout, 2008 ) , reinforcement learning (RL) ( Coons et al., 2008 ; Mirhoseini et al., 2017 ; Cummins et al., 2022 ; Park et al., 2022 ) , and more recently LLMs ( Pan et al., 2026 ; Qiu et al., 2026 ; Cummins et al., 2025 ) . Heuristic and RL-based methods typically start from candidate configurations and iteratively improve them using predefined rules or performance feedback, even though a trained RL agent can perform direct inference. We refer to this as a bottom-up search paradigm, whose selection knowledge is acquired by iteratively evaluating candidate configurations and learning from feedback. In contrast, LLMs can directly reason about suitable configurations, resembling a direct selection process.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，我们将为量子线路联合选择合适的设备与编译器选项这一问题形式化为量子编译器配置选择。 在经典编译器中，类似的问题是编译器自动调优，其解决方案包括启发式搜索（Chen et al., 2021；Zhu et al., 2024；Zhu et al., 2025；Garciarena and Santana, 2016；Pan et al., 2025；Hoste and Eeckhout, 2008）、强化学习（RL）（Coons et al., 2008；Mirhoseini et al., 2017；Cummins et al., 2022；Park et al., 2022），以及近来出现的大语言模型（Pan et al., 2026；Qiu et al., 2026；Cummins et al., 2025）。 启发式方法和基于强化学习的方法通常从候选配置出发，利用预定义规则或性能反馈对其进行迭代改进，即使训练好的强化学习智能体也可以执行直接推理。 我们将此称为自底向上的搜索范式，其选择知识是通过迭代评估候选配置并从反馈中学习而获得的。 相比之下，大语言模型可以直接推理出合适的配置，类似于一种直接选择的过程。

paragraphs.en: Additionally, classical compiler auto-tuning typically assumes a fixed target platform and may involve extremely large flag or pass spaces, e.g., up to 126 flags ( 2 126 2^{126} search space) in a recent GCC auto-tuning study ( Qiao et al., 2026 ) . Quantum compiler configuration differs in two important aspects. First, the target device is itself a selection dimension. The state-of-the-art (SOTA) method ( Quetschlich et al., 2025 ) adopts a two-stage workflow, using an ML model for device selection and an RL model for compiler option tuning. While this modular design facilitates new-device integration, a suboptimal device choice can impose a fidelity ceiling that subsequent option tuning cannot overcome.

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we systematically investigate the proposed top-down selection paradigm using the Qiskit compiler. We first construct QuOptBench, the first oracle-guided benchmark for Qiskit compiler configuration selection, covering 268 circuits with empirical oracle configurations. We then evaluate ten LLMs as a natural realization of direct selection. Results show that vanilla LLMs remain substantially below the oracle, largely due to their preference for overly aggressive configurations, such as higher optimization levels and more complex layout and routing methods.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们使用 Qiskit 编译器对所提出的自顶向下选择范式进行了系统性研究。 我们首先构建了 QuOptBench，这是首个用于 Qiskit 编译器配置选择的神谕引导基准，涵盖 268 个具有经验性神谕配置的电路。 随后，我们评估了十个大语言模型作为直接选择的自然实现。 结果表明，原始大语言模型仍显著落后于神谕，这主要是由于它们偏好过于激进的配置，例如更高的优化级别以及更复杂的布局与路由方法。

paragraphs.en: Motivated by this finding, we instead use a strong reasoning model, Claude-Opus-5 ( Claude, 2026 ) , to analyze oracle decisions on 68 carefully categorized and sampled circuits and distill 13 transferable device- and option-selection rules. Based on these rules, we develop QCompass, a lightweight rule-guided ML framework for selecting configurations for new circuits. Experimental results show that the distilled rules consistently improve LLM-based selection, while QCompass achieves higher fidelity with a favorable trade-off between configuration quality and inference overhead.

paragraphs.en: The main contributions of this work are summarized as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 本文的主要贡献总结如下：

paragraphs.en: We construct QuOptBench, the first exhaustive benchmark for the Qiskit quantum compiler configuration selection containing 268 circuits with empirical oracle configurations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们构建了 QuOptBench，这是首个针对 Qiskit 量子编译器配置选择的详尽基准，包含 268 个具有经验最优（oracle）配置的量子线路。

paragraphs.en: We investigate ten LLMs as a natural realization of direct quantum compiler configuration selection. Our empirical study shows that general-purpose LLM reasoning alone cannot reliably reproduce oracle-quality configurations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究了十个大语言模型，作为直接量子编译器配置选择的一种自然实现。 我们的实证研究表明，仅依靠通用大语言模型的推理无法可靠地复现出oracle质量的配置。

sents.en: We investigate ten LLMs as a natural realization of direct quantum compiler configuration selection.
sents.zh: 我们研究了十个大语言模型，作为直接量子编译器配置选择的一种自然实现。

sents.en: Our empirical study shows that general-purpose LLM reasoning alone cannot reliably reproduce oracle-quality configurations.
sents.zh: 我们的实证研究表明，仅依靠通用大语言模型的推理无法可靠地复现出oracle质量的配置。

paragraphs.en: We develop an oracle-guided rule-distillation workflow that contrasts O 3 O_{3} configurations with exhaustive-search oracles, explains their differences using circuit and device characteristics, and consolidates recurring patterns into transferable device- and option-selection rules.
paragraphs.zh: 我们开发了一种由预言机引导的规则蒸馏工作流，该工作流将 O 3 O_{3} 配置与穷举搜索预言机进行对比，利用电路和器件特性解释它们之间的差异，并将反复出现的模式整合为可迁移的器件选择与选项选择规则。

paragraphs.en: We design QCompass, a lightweight rule-guided learning and inference approach that applies the distilled rules to new circuits, shifting quantum compiler optimization from repeated bottom-up search to efficient top-down selection.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 QCompass，这是一种轻量级的规则引导学习与推理方法，可将蒸馏得到的规则应用于新电路，从而将量子编译器优化从重复的自底向上搜索转变为高效的自顶向下选择。

paragraphs.en: We conduct comprehensive evaluations of QCompass, including comparisons with bottom-up search methods, nearest-neighbor retrieval, and direct LLM-based selection, as well as generalization to additional circuits and devices.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对 QCompass 进行了全面评估，包括与自底向上搜索方法、最近邻检索以及直接基于大语言模型的选择的比较，以及向更多电路和器件的泛化。

paragraphs.en: The task of QuOptBench is to jointly select a device and compiler-option combination for each circuit. Following prior work ( Quetschlich et al., 2023 ; Quetschlich et al., 2025 ) , the selection is based on circuit- and device-level features. Circuit features cover seven metrics: qubit count, depth, program communication, critical depth, entanglement ratio, parallelism, and liveness. Device features characterize hardware capacity, noise, and connectivity, including qubit count, two-qubit and readout errors, T 1 T_{1} / T 2 T_{2} , average degree, and edge density. Together, these features provide the information needed for configuration selection.

paragraphs.en: Since directly simulating each compiled circuit to obtain its execution fidelity would incur prohibitive time and memory costs, we adopt estimated fidelity , a widely used proxy metric in prior quantum compiler configuration selection and pass tuning studies ( Quetschlich et al., 2023 ; Quetschlich et al., 2025 ; Zhong et al., 2026 ; Hasanat et al., 2026 ) . The original estimated fidelity F org F_{\mathrm{org}} in Eq. 1 is computed by multiplying the expected fidelities of all gates and measurement operations in the compiled circuit according to the hardware error information of the target device. In F org F_{\mathrm{org}} , F ⁡ ( g i ) F(g_{i}) denotes the expected execution fidelity of gate g i g_{i} on its mapped qubit(s), F RO ​ ( q j ) F_{\mathrm{RO}}(q_{j}) denotes the expected readout fidelity of qubit q j q_{j} , and | G | |G| and m m denote the numbers of gates and measurements in the compiled circuit, respectively. paragraphs.en: QuOptBench is the first quantum compiler configuration selection benchmark that provides empirical oracle configurations for each circuit. These oracles make QuOptBench a reusable reference for future research, enabling methods to measure both improvements over standard configurations (e.g., O 3 D ​ A O_{3}^{DA} ) and the remaining gap to the oracle, while supporting analyses of circuit-specific device and option choices. Although constructing the oracles is computationally expensive, this cost is incurred only once, enabling reproducible evaluation without repeating exhaustive search.
paragraphs.zh: QuOptBench 是首个量子编译器配置选择基准，为每个电路提供了经验性的最优（oracle）配置。 这些最优配置使 QuOptBench 成为未来研究的可复用参考，使各类方法既能衡量相对标准配置（例如 O 3 D ​ A O_{3}^{DA} ）的改进，也能衡量与最优配置之间仍存在的差距，同时支持针对特定电路的设备与选项选择的分析。 尽管构建这些最优配置在计算上开销高昂，但该成本仅需承担一次，从而无需重复穷举搜索即可实现可复现的评估。

paragraphs.en: Having established QuOptBench, we next investigate LLM-based configuration selection. Unlike bottom-up methods that iteratively search the configuration space, LLMs offer a natural alternative by directly predicting configurations, as explored in classical compiler tuning ( Qiu et al., 2026 ; Pan et al., 2026 ) . We therefore evaluate ten LLMs on QuOptBench to characterize their effectiveness.

We evaluate LLMs on QuOptBench using the F eff F_{\mathrm{eff}} improvement over O 3 D ​ A O^{DA}_{3} (defined in Sec. 2.2.5 ) as the primary metric, with compilation time as an efficiency metric. We measure improvement using the headroom-normalized gain, Imp ⁡ ( M ) = F eff M − F eff DA ​ - ​ O3 1 − F eff DA ​ - ​ O3 × 100 % \mathrm{Imp}(M)=\frac{F{{}_{\mathrm{eff}}}^{M}-F_{\mathrm{eff}}^{\mathrm{DA\text{-}O3}}}{1-F_{\mathrm{eff}}^{\mathrm{DA\text{-}O3}}}\times 100\% , where the denominator represents the remaining fidelity headroom of O 3 D ​ A O^{DA}_{3} . Positive and negative values indicate improvement and degradation, respectively. We compute the gain per circuit and report the average within each level; oracle improvement is computed analogously. We also report Better/Equal/Worse (denoted as "B/E/W") O 3 D ​ A O_{3}^{DA} as the numbers of cases where the selected configuration achieves higher, equal, or lower F eff F_{\mathrm{eff}} than O 3 D ​ A O_{3}^{DA} . In addition, we report p p -values from paired Wilcoxon signed-rank tests ( Woolson, 2008 ) for both the selected configurations and the oracle against O 3 D ​ A O_{3}^{DA} . The tests are performed on per-circuit paired F eff F_{\mathrm{eff}} values; pairs with zero differences are excluded from the signed-rank calculation following the Wilcoxon convention. We consider cases with p < 0.05 p<0.05 statistically significant.

paragraphs.en: We further analyze GPT-5.5, the best-performing LLM on average in Table 3 , and compare its predicted device-option distribution with the oracle in Fig. 2 . We quantitatively analyze all LLMs in the next subsection. As shown in Fig. 3 , GPT-5.5 selects FakeAuckland about 20% more often and FakeBrisbane about 20% less often. It also favors more aggressive compiler options, including O 3 O_{3} , sabre for layout and routing, and synthesis for translation. We refer to this tendency as configuration aggressiveness , i.e., a preference for more complex and transformation-intensive compilation strategies. However, the oracle distribution shows that less aggressive choices, such as O 2 O_{2} , dense layout, and basic routing, can also achieve higher fidelity and shorter compilation time. This suggests that vanilla LLMs over-rely on conventionally "strong" settings rather than adapting to circuit- and device-specific characteristics.

paragraphs.en: To better characterize the aggressiveness of different configurations, we introduce an aggressiveness metric . As shown in Table 4 , we assign an aggressiveness score to each candidate device and compiler-option value. For devices, aggressiveness captures the tendency to select a stronger or larger hardware target rather than compilation intensity itself. We consider three hardware characteristics: qubit capacity, topology connectivity, and gate error. A device with more qubits, higher connectivity, and lower gate error represents a stronger hardware choice and is therefore assigned a higher aggressiveness score. For compiler options, we assign scores according to the complexity and transformation intensity of each option, as detailed in Sec. 3.3.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 为了更好地刻画不同配置的激进程度，我们引入一个激进程度指标。 如表 4 所示，我们为每个候选设备和编译器选项值分配一个激进程度分数。 对于设备而言，激进程度体现的是选择更强或更大硬件目标的倾向，而不是编译强度本身。 我们考虑三个硬件特性：量子比特容量、拓扑连通性和门错误率。 量子比特更多、连通性更高且门错误率更低的设备代表更强的硬件选择，因此会被分配更高的激进程度分数。 对于编译器选项，我们根据每个选项的复杂度和变换强度来分配分数，详见第 3.3.1 节。

paragraphs.en: For each sampled case, we provide Claude-Opus-5 ( Claude, 2026 ) with the O 3 D ​ A O_{3}^{DA} and oracle configurations, circuit features, and device features. paragraphs.en: Distilled rules in Table 6 reveal three common patterns. First, device selection depends on circuit width and communication: low-occupancy circuits can benefit from wider devices, while high-communication circuits favor better connectivity and lower two-qubit error. Second, aggressive compilation is not universally beneficial; simple, serial, or near-full-device circuits often prefer lower optimization levels, whereas O 3 O_{3} is mainly useful when sufficient optimization opportunity exists. Third, translation should match circuit structure: near-native circuits generally favor lightweight non-synthesis translation, while synthesis is more useful for unsupported or higher-arity operations. Overall, these patterns show that effective configuration selection requires circuit- and device-specific adaptation rather than a fixed aggressive strategy.
paragraphs.zh: 表 6 中提炼出的规则揭示了三种常见模式。 第一，设备选择取决于电路宽度与通信：低占用率电路可以从更宽的设备中受益，而高通信电路则更青睐更好的连接性和更低的双比特门错误率。 第二，激进编译并非普遍有益；简单、串行或接近整个设备的电路往往更适合较低的优化级别，而 O 3 O_{3} 主要在存在足够优化空间时才有用。 第三，翻译方式应与电路结构相匹配：接近原生的电路通常适合轻量级的非合成翻译，而合成对于不支持的操作或更高元数的操作更有用。 总体而言，这些模式表明，有效的配置选择需要针对电路和设备的自适应调整，而不是固定的激进策略。

paragraphs.en: By scoring only a rule-pruned candidate set with lightweight models, QCompass avoids both repeated online compilation in bottom-up search and the high reasoning latency of LLM-based top-down selection, providing a fast realization of the proposed top-down configuration selection paradigm.

paragraphs.en: Baselines. For bottom-up baselines, we evaluate reinforcement learning (RL) and Bayesian optimization (BO). We re-implement MQT Predictor ( Quetschlich et al., 2025 ) , a two-stage approach that uses ML for device selection and PPO ( Schulman et al., 2017 ) for compiler-option tuning, under Qiskit V2.4.1 (originally developed for V0.39.2). To retrain both stages under the updated Qiskit version, we construct the training pool using the original train dataset used by MQT Predictor together with QCircuitBench ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , a large-scale quantum-circuit dataset. After removing circuits overlapping with QuOptBench, we sample 2,000 circuits, four times the original training-set size of 500, using 95% for training and 5% for validation. Following the MQT Predictor, which trains seven candidate ML models to predict the device that achieves the highest estimated fidelity under the O 3 O_{3} setting and selects the best-performing model for device selection, we train the same seven models. In our setting, Random Forest and Decision Tree achieve the highest validation accuracy and are included in the evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 基线方法。 对于自下而上的基线方法，我们评估了强化学习（RL）和贝叶斯优化（BO）。 我们在 Qiskit V2.4.1（最初针对 V0.39.2 开发）下重新实现了 MQT Predictor（Quetschlich 等，2025），这是一种两阶段方法，使用机器学习进行设备选择，并使用 PPO（Schulman 等，2017）进行编译器选项调优。 为了在更新的 Qiskit 版本下重新训练这两个阶段，我们使用 MQT Predictor 原始训练数据集以及 QCircuitBench（Yang 等，2025）——一个大规模量子线路数据集——来构建训练池。 在移除与 QuOptBench 重叠的线路后，我们采样了 2,000 条线路，是原始训练集规模 500 的四倍，其中 95% 用于训练，5% 用于验证。 遵循 MQT Predictor 的做法，即训练七个候选机器学习模型来预测在 O 3 O_{3} 设置下能实现最高估计保真度的设备，并选择表现最好的模型用于设备选择，我们训练了同样的七个模型。 在我们的设置中，随机森林和决策树取得了最高的验证准确率，因此被纳入评估。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Table 7 , incorporating the distilled rules consistently improves LLM performance on quantum compiler configuration selection across all LLMs and all three levels, providing direct evidence of the effectiveness of the distilled rules. For Levels 2 and 3, most LLMs achieve positive gains over O 3 D ​ A O_{3}^{DA} ; notably, Qwen3.5-397B-A17B improves over O 3 D ​ A O_{3}^{DA} by 20.37% on average for Level 3. For Level 1, however, most models still show slight degradation, with Seed-2.0-Lite exhibiting a larger drop of 15.89%. These results show that the distilled rules help LLMs identify better configurations when sufficient optimization headroom exists. However, LLMs still struggle on Level 1, where O 3 D ​ A O_{3}^{DA} is already near optimal and unnecessary changes should be avoided. The statistical results show the same trend: all rule-guided LLMs remain significantly different from O 3 D ​ A O_{3}^{DA} on Level 1, whereas on Level 3, seven of ten models achieve statistically significant positive gains ( p < 0.05 p<0.05 ); Level 2 shows a more mixed pattern.

paragraphs.en: For BO and RL, most variants underperform O 3 D ​ A O_{3}^{DA} on Levels 1 and 2, except Device-Aware BO. This suggests that device-selection errors can trap BO on suboptimal devices, while RL tends to make unnecessary option changes even when the O 3 D ​ A O_{3}^{DA} device is fixed. On Level 3, however, most BO/RL variants outperform Device-Aware BO, indicating that larger optimization headroom allows alternative device choices and more aggressive option tuning to provide greater gains. NN-Retrieval underperforms Device-Aware RL/BO across all three levels, achieving only a 5.24% improvement over O 3 D ​ A O_{3}^{DA} on Level 3. This indicates that directly reusing configurations from similar circuits is insufficient, while distillation of transferable rules is considerably more effective.

paragraphs.en: We further evaluate the adaptation ability of the distilled rules and QCompass on new circuits and devices. paragraphs.en: As shown in Table 9 , removing the policy gate causes the largest degradation on Level 1, confirming the importance of avoiding unnecessary exploration when O 3 D ​ A O_{3}^{DA} is already near optimal. paragraphs.en: Compiler Auto-tuning. Classical compiler auto-tuning has explored heuristic search ( Chen et al., 2021 ; Zhu et al., 2024 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ; Garciarena and Santana, 2016 ; Pan et al., 2025 ; Hoste and Eeckhout, 2008 ) , RL-based pass selection ( Coons et al., 2008 ; Mirhoseini et al., 2017 ; Cummins et al., 2022 ; Park et al., 2022 ; Kulkarni and Cavazos, 2012 ; Huang et al., 2019 ) , similarity-based retrieval ( Trümper et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2024 ) , and LLM-guided optimization ( Pan et al., 2026 ; Qiu et al., 2026 ; Cummins et al., 2025 ) . Quantum compiler tuning has also adopted heuristic and RL-based methods ( Quetschlich et al., 2025 ; Hasanat et al., 2026 ; Quetschlich et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Mills et al., 2026 ; Dangwal et al., 2025 ) . However, only two of these studies ( Quetschlich et al., 2023 ; Quetschlich et al., 2025 ) focus on compiler configuration selection with the bottom-up RL method. In this paper, we explore a top-down selection paradigm, achieving better performance than existing methods.

paragraphs.en: Internal Validity . The main internal threat lies in oracle construction, which is bounded by the selected devices, option space, timeout policy, and estimated fidelity proxy. We mitigate this by using identical devices, option spaces and settings for all methods. Another threat comes from our re-implementation of MQT Predictor ( Quetschlich et al., 2025 ) . Since the original MQT Predictor was developed under Qiskit V0.39.2, its search space is not identical to our Qiskit V2.4.1 setting, and our reproduced models therefore cannot exactly match the original implementation. To mitigate this threat, we follow its reported two-stage methodology and model choices and adopt the same training hyperparameters, except that we increase the training steps by 10 × \times . Finally, LLM nondeterminism and parsing errors may affect results; we mitigate them by fixing the temperature to 0.0 and seed to 42. Another internal threat arises from the manual verification of the LLM-distilled rules and may therefore introduce researcher judgment. We mitigate this threat by checking each distilled rule against its supporting cases and removing redundant or overly case-specific statements.
paragraphs.zh: 内部效度。 主要的内部威胁在于oracle的构建，其受限于所选设备、选项空间、超时策略以及估计的保真度代理指标。 我们通过对所有方法使用相同的设备、选项空间和设置来缓解这一威胁。 另一个威胁来自我们对MQT Predictor（Quetschlich et al., 2025）的重新实现。 由于原版MQT Predictor是在Qiskit V0.39.2下开发的，其搜索空间与我们的Qiskit V2.4.1设置并不完全相同，因此我们复现的模型无法与原实现完全一致。 为缓解这一威胁，我们遵循其报告的两阶段方法论与模型选择，并采用相同的训练超参数，只是将训练步数增加了10 × \times倍。 最后，大语言模型的非确定性和解析错误可能影响结果；我们通过将temperature固定为0.0、将seed固定为42来缓解这一问题。 另一个内部威胁来自对大语言模型提炼规则的人工验证，因此可能引入研究者的主观判断。 我们通过将每条提炼出的规则与其支持案例进行核对，并删除冗余或过于针对特定案例的表述，来缓解这一威胁。

paragraphs.en: External Validity . Our results are based on the evaluated circuit benchmarks, fake backends, Qiskit V2.4.1, and selected compiler options. Although QuOptBench contains diverse QASMBench and VeriQBench circuits, the distilled rules and QCompass may not fully generalize to substantially different workloads, hardware architectures, or future compiler versions. Moreover, most experiments use estimated fidelity, while real devices may additionally be affected by calibration drift, crosstalk, and runtime noise. We partially mitigate these threats through evaluations on new circuits and devices ( Sec. 6.4 ) and an additional noise-aware execution fidelity experiment on the noisy simulator ( Sec. 6.5 ), but broader compiler and real-hardware evaluations remain future work.

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we explore a top-down paradigm for quantum compiler configuration selection. We construct QuOptBench with empirical oracle configurations, use these oracles to distill transferable configuration rules, and apply them to new circuits. We further develop QCompass, a rule-guided framework for fast configuration selection. Our results show that QCompass achieves best overall quality–latency trade-off compared with baselines.
paragraphs.zh: 本文探索了一种自上而下的量子编译器配置选择范式。 我们基于经验性最优（oracle）配置构建了 QuOptBench，利用这些 oracle 蒸馏出可迁移的配置规则，并将其应用于新电路。 我们进一步开发了 QCompass，一个用于快速配置选择的规则引导框架。 我们的结果表明，与基线方法相比，QCompass 实现了最佳的整体质量–时延权衡。
